selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: What did the traveler begin to study in this passage?
questions.answer: He began to study what clear minds and pure hearts showed about believing in Allah’s oneness.

questions.question: Did the passage say these intellects had only small differences or very real differences?
questions.answer: It says they had real differences, even including opposing outlooks.

questions.question: What does the passage suggest about the source of their confidence?
questions.answer: It suggests their confidence comes from one constant truth.

questions.question: What picture is used for the agreement of these intellects about Allah’s existence and oneness?
questions.answer: It is pictured as a strong shining chain and a bright window to truth.

questions.question: What second group gave witness besides intellects?
questions.answer: Bright and healthy hearts gave witness too.

questions.question: How is each heart honored in the passage?
questions.answer: Each heart is shown as a place where divine knowledge is reflected in a broad way.

questions.question: When all the hearts are looked at together, what are they compared to?
questions.answer: They are compared to a great mirror and to a sea reflecting the sun.

questions.question: What false idea does the passage strongly push away?
questions.answer: It pushes away the idea that all these people were simply mistaken or tricked by illusion.

questions.question: After thinking about all this, what did the traveler say?
questions.answer: He said, “I have believed in Allah.”

questions.question: Who are the two main witnesses discussed in this passage?
questions.answer: Upright intellects and sound, luminous hearts.

questions.question: What kinds of variety existed among those intellects?
questions.answer: There was variety in their ability, methods, and viewpoints.

questions.question: If many different minds hold one same conviction, what conclusion does the passage lead us to?
questions.answer: It leads us to conclude that the conviction rests on one firm truth.

questions.question: What does the bright window image help us understand?
questions.answer: It helps us understand that their agreement lets a person see truth more clearly.

questions.question: What did the traveler see about the sound and luminous hearts?
questions.answer: He saw that their spiritual discoveries and witnessings also agreed.

questions.question: What is surprising about their agreement?
questions.answer: It is surprising because they still agreed even though their paths were different.

questions.question: What stronger picture is given when all the hearts are joined together?
questions.answer: Together they are like a huge mirror or a sea shining back the sun.

questions.question: Why does the passage say error cannot explain all this agreement?
questions.answer: Because widespread, steady agreement among many clear-sighted people cannot reasonably come from falsehood.

questions.question: What role does the heart play in the traveler’s conclusion?
questions.answer: The heart joins reason by reflecting and witnessing the same truth.

questions.question: At the start of this passage, what did the traveler notice about luminous intellects?
questions.answer: He noticed that they all held the same strong belief in Allah’s unity.

questions.question: Even though those intellects were different, what was the same among them?
questions.answer: Their belief and strong certainty about Allah being One was the same.

questions.question: What does the passage mean by saying their roots were deep?
questions.answer: It means their certainty was grounded strongly and could not easily be removed.

questions.question: What two word-pictures are used for the shared faith of the intellects?
questions.answer: A shining chain and a bright window.

questions.question: Did those hearts all follow one identical path?
questions.answer: No. Their ways and styles were different.

questions.question: What truth were those hearts showing?
questions.answer: They were showing Allah’s necessary existence and oneness.
